sections.title: Problem it solves
sections.text: Stack traces contain **stripped namespaces / assembly-qualified tokens**. [`Lyo.PackageMetadata`](../Lyo.PackageMetadata/README.md) resolves **“what NuGet/Git package owns this prefix?”** for diagnostics overlays. **`PostgresPackageMetadataStore`** implements the store against normalized tables (**`PackageStackPrefix`** rows ordered by * *`NormalizedPrefix`** length) so resolution is **`O(sorted prefixes)` in-process** after each DB read (bulk API loads all prefixes once per call when caching allows).

sections.title: Storage model (conceptual)
items: **`PackageMetadataEntity`** holds catalog metadata (**id, package name, version range, SPDX/license expression blobs**, etc.—see EF configurations).

sections.title: Implementing behaviors — Bulk resolution (`TryGetManyForStrippedMethodPrefixesAsync`)
items: Input: list of **distinct** stripped prefixes (typically one per decoded stack frame subtree).
Output: dictionary **including one entry per input key**, value **`null`** when nothing matches contract rules.
**Never** silently drop requested keys—that invariant keeps **`Lyo.Diagnostic`** bulk decode paths deterministic.

sections.title: Implementing behaviors — Prefix catalog caching (`PostgresPrefixCatalogCachingMode`)
rows: Maintain an immutable in-process snapshot; reload when mutations bump generation counter (**`ClearPrefixCatalogCache`** or **`RegisterManyAsync`** on same instance).
Always hit Postgres (wrap with outer cache yourself if importing huge catalogs asynchronously).
sections.trail:
`ClearPrefixCatalogCache()` is harmless when caching disabled (**only bumps generation**).

Cross-process writes **do not** invalidate—document that for ops (*disable snapshot* or bust cache after CLI imports).

sections.title: Migrations & schema
sections.text: Migrations ship under **`Migrations/`** (schema/table names follow **`PostgresPackageMetadataOptions.Schema`** conventions—inspect snapshot for authoritative DDL).

sections.title: See also
items: [`Lyo.Diagnostic`](../../Diagnostic/Lyo.Diagnostic/README.md) stack decode + breadcrumb tooling that **optionally consumes** **`IPackageMetadataStore`**.
